additional_implementation_for_other_phys.reason: Momentum evolution and reciprocal bath sources now run. The X amplitudes and derived multidimensional kernels, neutrino flavour density matrices/oscillations, number-changing glueball collisions and possible condensates are not inferred from supplied cell rates.

additional_implementation_for_other_phys.item: hadronic cascades and fully coupled thermal deposition
additional_implementation_for_other_phys.reason: Charged-pion n/p conversion now acts on the evolving native network using supplied parent distributions and collision kernels. Predicting hadronization, slowing, pion depletion, other nuclear reactions and reciprocal thermal deposition throughout active BBN remains open.

All six Born/static-nucleon processes now run and agree with independent LINX Born quadrature. Radiative, finite-nucleon-mass, weak-magnetism and thermal/QED corrections for arbitrary spectra remain open; the audit cannot count these Born histories as precision-complete.

additional_implementation_for_other_phys.item: interacting X outside elastic ETHOS IDM-IDR
additional_implementation_for_other_phys.reason: A genuine pinned CLASS interacting family now runs with history-derived parameters. Decays/production, perturbed energy transfer, nonthermal or semirelativistic components, isocurvature and transition stress require further equations; pure confined SU3 is not automatically cold IDM plus massless IDR.

additional_implementation_for_other_phys.item: global feedback of pocket population and surfaces
additional_implementation_for_other_phys.reason: Actual-history geometry and a pressure/cooling spherical pocket closure are implemented separately. Their simultaneous embedding into P7 with model-specific trapping, surface transport, emission spectra and no double-counted latent heat remains open.

additional_implementation_for_other_phys.item: common cosmology and nuisance profile over actual X histories
additional_implementation_for_other_phys.reason: A finite paired grid now reruns keyed P7/P8/P9 DAGs and calculates separate extrema for native nuclear engines. A physically calibrated X family, continuous likelihood exploration and accounting for sky overlap remain open.

additional_implementation_for_other_phys.item: metastable donor EOS and complete glueball/portal network
additional_implementation_for_other_phys.reason: The donor EOS contains only stable one-sided phases and marginal node errors. Metastable continuation, joint EOS covariance, continuum nucleation, multiple C-even/C-odd modes, hadronic widths and thermalization are not supplied by the stable scalar controls.
